claim_scope: Exact UTF-8 source-span addressing and independently recomputable SHA-256 metadata for every fragment produced from the pinned corpus.

corpus_rules.newlines: as stored in git (LF), identical on every platform
corpus_rules.sampling: none — every file matching the rules is measured

limitations: This measures fragment fidelity and digest recomputability, not retrieval recall.
It does not measure generated-answer correctness, latency, or provider cost.
The corpus is one pinned revision of the Entroly repository.
